source: lab (captured, real recording; background replaced by flat green via Segment Anything 2)

camera.motion: static (no background visible; both people stand on fixed feet positions, far person feet at y=271 every frame to <1 px)
camera.intrinsics_hint_from_benchmark: Orbbec Femto Mega, HFOV 80 deg -> f = 0.5959*1280 = 763 px, principal point ~ (640, 360)
camera.view: high camera looking steeply down onto the floor; far person stands upright at top-centre (head/upper body cut by top edge), near person stands at bottom-left, very close to camera, cut by left and bottom edges, appearing strongly slanted (wide-angle + oblique view)

perspective_cues.note: no floor texture or horizon visible (green background); the far person is much smaller (legs+torso ~272 px tall visible) than the near person; objects shrink as they fly from near to far person

white_ball.description: small white (slightly grey-shaded) ball, ~30-36 px across; starts in the near person's right hand, thrown underarm up to the far person, who catches it with both hands

apparent_size_px.note: mask extents; in flight there is motion blur along the motion direction, so width_across is the better diameter estimate; in hands partly occluded

yellow_fruit.description: yellow elongated fruit (banana/mango-like, pale yellow with a dark green-brown stem end); starts hanging in the far person's right hand (image-left of her), thrown underarm to the near person, who catches it with both hands near her chest
yellow_fruit.visible_frames: 0-3, 8-27, 38-48 (hidden behind far person's leg/hand 4-7, inside near person's hands / behind her hair 28-37)

apparent_size_px.note: long axis length in flight grows from ~45 to ~80 px as it approaches the near person (and with blur / rotation); width across ~31-35 px in flight

person_near.description: person with long dark-brown hair, dark grey oversized T-shirt, black trousers, white sneakers; bottom-left, close to camera, cut by left/bottom edge; throws the white ball, catches the yellow fruit
person_near.moves: stands in place (feet fixed), arms move; body leans/turns slightly
person_near.reference_point: mask centroid (pelvis not reliably visible; body cut by frame)

extent_px_frame0.visible_body_length_diagonal_px: head top (~0,130) to right shoe tip (~389,660): ~660 px (head partly cut)

person_far.description: person in light grey fitted T-shirt, dark navy/black cargo trousers, white sneakers, wristwatch on left wrist; stands at top-centre facing the camera; throws the yellow fruit, catches the white ball
person_far.moves: stands in place (feet fixed at ~(730,271)), bends forward and moves arms while catching
person_far.visible_frames: 0-48 (head cut by top edge, visible from chest/shoulders down)

extent_px_frame0.feet_spacing_px: shoes at x~715 and ~743, soles y~255-271

static_objects: none: background replaced by uniform green; watermark "Modified with Segment Anything 2 Demo" box at bottom-right (x 1030-1280, y 690-720) is an overlay, not a scene object
